name: Mara Dawnblade
lore: A wandering swordswoman who keeps the old orchard roads safe.

primary.name: Sword Cut
primary.description: Tap for a quick directional sword cut (28 damage). Hold up to 1s, then release a heavy 46.2-damage cut with up to 70 knockback. Bleed still applies when unlocked.

special.name: Dawn Circle
special.description: Unleash a bright circular sword sweep for 48 damage within 115 units. A golden boundary, blade trails and radiant burst show its full attack area.

passive: Open Wound: Sword Cut causes bleeding for 2 damage per second for 4 seconds. Repeated hits refresh it.

technique.name: Distant Dawn
technique.description: Dawn Circle reaches 40% farther, dealing 25% less damage.

final_technique.name: Dawnblades Aloft
final_technique.description: Throw two dawn blades that curve back, 13 per leg. Trades fast close melee for slower ranged timing; her bleed passive still applies.

attack.name: Dawnblades Aloft
attack.description: Throw two dawn blades that curve back, 13 per leg. Trades fast close melee for slower ranged timing; her bleed passive still applies.
